SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P2' AND published_on<='2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT (v2.value - v1.value)*100.0/v1.value AS value FROM (SELECT SUM(transfer_units) AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P1' AND published_on<='2024-07-05') AS v1, (SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P2' AND published_on<='2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1) AS v2;
